scope: A finite fixed-identity source and energy interpretation of the unchanged renewable-learning body rules (reopen=true, refill=true), for both the registered normal kernel and its original marginal-ghost cut. The construction uses an explicitly recharged four-unit accessible source and twelve reusable identities, a sufficient bound rather than a minimum. All actual-intake recovery horizons, original state scores and the uniform quarter maintenance gap are preserved. Physical rates, entropy calibration, full encoding and full L1-L6 remain separate.

CGB.BufferedMaterial.transport_exists.name: CGB.BufferedMaterial.transport_exists
CGB.BufferedMaterial.transport_exists.signature:
∀ (o : CGB.BufferedMaterial.Owners) (b b' i d : ℕ),
  CGB.BufferedMaterial.Stock b o →
    b ≤ 4 →
      i ≤ 4 →
        d ≤ b →
          b' + d = b + i →
            ∃ o',
              CGB.BufferedMaterial.Stock b' o' ∧
                CGB.MaterialSource.Allowed o o' ∧
                  CGB.MaterialSource.moved o o' CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body = i ∧
                    CGB.MaterialSource.moved o o' CGB.MaterialSource.Place.body CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink = d ∧
                      CGB.MaterialSource.moved o o' CGB.MaterialSource.Place.sink CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source = i

CGB.BufferedMaterial.refines.name: CGB.BufferedMaterial.refines
CGB.BufferedMaterial.refines.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  {P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ E} (B : CGB.BufferedMaterial.Rules P),
  CGB.Interaction.Refines (CGB.BufferedMaterial.physical B) P (CGB.BufferedMaterial.project B)

CGB.BufferedMaterial.realized.name: CGB.BufferedMaterial.realized
CGB.BufferedMaterial.realized.signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  {P : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ E} (B : CGB.BufferedMaterial.Rules P) (clock : ℝ),
  0 < clock →
    CGB.MaterialSource.Realization (CGB.BufferedMaterial.physical B) P (CGB.BufferedMaterial.owner B)
      (CGB.BufferedMaterial.project B) B.content B.incoming B.outgoing clock

CGB.RecoveryTransport.firstHit_eq.name: CGB.RecoveryTransport.firstHit_eq
CGB.RecoveryTransport.firstHit_eq.signature:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] [inst_2 : Fintype S]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq S] [inst_4 : Fintype E] {P : CGB.Interaction.Machine R ℕ E} {Q : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ E}
  {f : R → S},
  CGB.Interaction.Refines P Q f →
    ∀ (a : ℕ → R → E → R → Bool) (b : ℕ → S → E → S → Bool),
      (∀ (t : ℕ) (r : R) (e : E) (r' : R), 0 < P.step t r e r' → a t r e r' = b t (f r) e (f r')) →
        ∀ (t k : ℕ) (r : R),
          CGB.EventChannels.Kernel.firstHit (CGB.Energetics.events P) a t k r =
            CGB.EventChannels.Kernel.firstHit (CGB.Energetics.events Q) b t k (f r)

CGB.RecoveryTransport.mean_eq.name: CGB.RecoveryTransport.mean_eq
CGB.RecoveryTransport.mean_eq.signature:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] [inst_2 : Fintype S]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq S] [inst_4 : Fintype E] {P : CGB.Interaction.Machine R ℕ E} {Q : CGB.Interaction.Machine S ℕ E}
  {f : R → S},
  CGB.Interaction.Refines P Q f →
    ∀ (initial : R) (n : ℕ) (g : S → ℝ),
      (CGB.Energetics.mean (CGB.Energetics.law P initial n) fun r => g (f r)) =
        CGB.Energetics.mean (CGB.Energetics.law Q (f initial) n) g

CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.realized.name: CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.realized
CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.realized.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool),
  CGB.MaterialSource.Realization (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.physical cut)
    (CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true cut) (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.owner cut)
    (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.project cut) (fun z => (CGB.RenewableLearning.plant true true).total z.1)
    (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.declared (CGB.RenewableLearning.incoming true))
    (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.declared (CGB.RenewableLearning.outgoing true true)) CGB.RenewableLearning.world.clock

CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.recovery_pr.name: CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.recovery_preserved
CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.recovery_pr.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool) (t k : ℕ) (r : CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.Carrier cut),
  CGB.EventChannels.Kernel.firstHit (CGB.Energetics.events (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.physical cut))
      (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.intake cut) t k r =
    CGB.Exchange.recovery (CGB.RenewableLearning.plant true true) CGB.RenewableLearning.world ⋯
      (CGB.RenewableLearning.ledger true true) cut (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.world.sense) t k
      (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.project cut r)

CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.recovery_by.name: CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.recovery_by_certificate
CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.recovery_by.signature:
∀ (t : ℕ) (r : CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.Carrier false),
  CGB.RenewableRecoveryCertificate.certificate.region (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.project false r) →
    CGB.EventChannels.Kernel.firstHit (CGB.Energetics.events (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.physical false))
        (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.intake false) t CGB.RenewableLearning.world.horizon r =
      1

CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.score_prese.name: CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.score_preserved
CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.score_prese.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool) (n : ℕ),
  CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.score cut n =
    CGB.Exchange.survival (CGB.RenewableLearning.plant true true) CGB.RenewableLearning.world ⋯
      (CGB.RenewableLearning.ledger true true) cut (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.world.sense) n

CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.maintenance.name: CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.maintenance_preserved
CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.maintenance.signature:
(∀ (n : ℕ), CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.score false n = 1) ∧
  ∀ (n : ℕ), 6 ≤ n → CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.score true n + 1 / 4 ≤ CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.score false n

CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.stock_and_r.name: CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.stock_and_recharge
CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.stock_and_r.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool) (t : ℕ) (r r' : CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.Carrier cut) (e : Option Unit),
  0 < (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.physical cut).step t r e r' →
    CGB.MaterialSource.count (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.owner cut r) CGB.MaterialSource.Place.source = 4 ∧
      (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.sourceAccount cut).drive t r e r' =
        ↑(CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.declared (CGB.RenewableLearning.incoming true) t
            (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.project cut r) e (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.project cut r'))

CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.source_ener.name: CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.source_energy_budget
CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.source_ener.signature:
∀ (cut : Bool) (n : ℕ),
  CGB.Energetics.mean
        (CGB.Energetics.law (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.physical cut)
          (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.initialCarrier cut) n)
        ((CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.sourceAccount cut).stored n) +
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
        CGB.Energetics.flux (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.physical cut)
          (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.initialCarrier cut) (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.release cut) t =
    6 +
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n,
        CGB.Energetics.flux (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.physical cut)
          (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.initialCarrier cut) (CGB.RenewableLearningCarrier.sourceAccount cut).drive t
